visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera is positioned at a high angle, looking down at two Corgis sitting on a tiled floor inside a room. The room is dimly lit with warm artificial light. (2) A hand enters the frame from the top left, pointing toward the Corgis. The Corgis stand up and begin to move as the camera follows them. Green plastic crates are stacked against a wall in the background. (3) The person walks forward, and the camera pans to show the Corgis excitedly following. They move through a doorway with red and white signage toward an outdoor area. (4) One Corgi with a docked tail walks quickly onto a paved sidewalk at night. The lighting shifts to bright, cool artificial streetlights and neon glows from nearby storefronts. The Corgi walks away from the camera down the sidewalk.
